topic_en: Rust enum + match: handle every case

xhs.title: Rust 漏写一种情况，直接编译不过？
xhs.body:
第 11 课：enum + match
enum 列出所有可能，一个值同一时刻只是其中一种
match 每种情况一个分支，而且是表达式，能直接赋值
漏写一种？编译器报错 E0004，这就叫穷尽
_ 能兜底，但以后新加的情况也会被它悄悄吞掉
考考你：enum Dir { Up, Down, Left }，match d 里只写 Dir::Up 和 _，能编译吗？ 评论区告诉我～

linkedin.title: In Rust, a forgotten case is a compile error
linkedin.body:
An enum lists every possibility; a value is exactly one of them.
match gives one arm per case, and it is an expression, so it returns a value.
Miss a case and the build fails (E0004). Add a new variant later, and the compiler points to every match you need to update.
The _ catch-all is handy, but it also hides new variants.
Quick quiz: enum Dir { Up, Down, Left }, and a match on d with only Dir::Up and _. Does it compile? Answer in the comments.

quiz.q_zh: enum Dir { Up, Down, Left }，match d 里只写 Dir::Up 和 _，能编译吗？
quiz.q_en: enum Dir { Up, Down, Left }, and a match on d with only Dir::Up and _. Does it compile?
quiz.answer_zh: 答案：能。_ 匹配剩下的所有情况（Down 和 Left），所以 match 是穷尽的，输出 up。
quiz.answer_en: Answer: yes. _ matches every remaining case (Down and Left), so the match is exhaustive. It prints up.
